intro.en: Visitors love Sayulita and San Pancho for incredible fresh food, world-class surfing, and laid-back Pacific beach culture.
intro.es: Los visitantes aman Sayulita y San Pancho por comida fresca increíble, surfing de clase mundial, y cultura de playa relajada.

picks.name: Mary's Taco Sayulita
picks.en: Life-changing fish and shrimp tacos everyone raves about.
picks.es: Tacos de pez y camarón increíbles que todos adoran.

picks.name: La Lancha Beach
picks.en: Popular surf spot with lessons; locals and tourists love it.
picks.es: Lugar de surf popular con lecciones; locales y turistas lo aman.

picks.name: Don Pedro's Restaurant & Bar
picks.en: Upstairs offers intimate views and good food; downstairs is louder.
picks.es: Arriba ofrece vistas íntimas y buena comida; abajo es más ruidoso.

picks.name: Lo de Marcos
picks.en: Nearby mellow beach town with beautiful sand; great for families.
picks.es: Pueblo playa cercano con arena hermosa; excelente para familias.

picks.name: Sayulita Sandbar
picks.en: New bar with games and sports on TV.
picks.es: Bar nuevo con juegos (pickleball, ping pong, cornhole) y deportes.

picks.name: Playa Los Muertos
picks.en: Smaller, less crowded beach with rocks that create gentle swimming.
picks.es: Playa más pequeña y tranquila con rocas que crean nado suave.

picks.name: Playa Carricitos
picks.en: Secluded beach with stunning sunsets and beautiful scenery.
picks.es: Playa aislada con atardeceres impresionantes y escenario hermoso.

picks.name: Public House
picks.en: Plaza bar with a more reliable ATM than many places.
picks.es: Bar en plaza con cajero automático más confiable que otros.

picks.name: Tacos Al Pastor Tal Ivan
picks.en: Reliable taco stand in main square with long hours.
picks.es: Puesto de tacos confiable en plaza mayor con horario extendido.

picks.name: Hotelito Los Sueños
picks.en: Budget-friendly hotel close to beach with daily breakfast and vegan options.
picks.es: Hotel económico cerca de playa con desayuno buffet diario y opciones veganas.

picks.name: Sur 38
picks.en: Upscale tapas and wine restaurant, quieter than most.
picks.es: Restaurante upscale de tapas y vino, más tranquilo que otros.

picks.name: Surf It Out
picks.en: Best-reviewed surf instructor Risa teaches personalized lessons here.
picks.es: La mejor instructora de surf Risa enseña lecciones personalizadas aquí.

picks.name: Tacos Toño
picks.en: Local favorite for best tacos, with excellent condiments bar.
picks.es: Favorito local para los mejores tacos, con excelente barra de condimentos.

picks.name: Alley Cat Tours
picks.en: Eco-friendly all-inclusive snorkel boat tours with great food.
picks.es: Tours de snorkel en bote ecológicos y todo incluido con buena comida.

picks.name: Alto Alto
picks.en: Mediterranean upscale restaurant perfect for special dinners.
picks.es: Restaurante mediterráneo upscale perfecto para cenas especiales.

picks.name: Aaleyah's Wings
picks.en: Famous for margaritas made with owner's family tequila recipe.
picks.es: Famoso por margaritas hechas con receta de tequila de la familia.

picks.name: Viajero Hostel
picks.en: Social hostel with nightly activities, pool, and communal atmosphere.
picks.es: Hostal social con actividades nocturnas, piscina, y ambiente comunitario.

picks.name: Pineapple Paradise
picks.en: Great for people-watching with excellent sandwiches and fun karaoke.
picks.es: Excelente para observar gente con sándwiches excelentes y karaoke divertido.

picks.name: My Sister's House
picks.en: Affordable women-only hostel with outdoor cooking facilities.
picks.es: Hostal económico solo para mujeres con instalaciones de cocina al aire libre.

picks.name: Monkey Mountain
picks.en: Popular hiking spot; guides available for best experience.
picks.es: Lugar de senderismo popular; guías disponibles para mejor experiencia.

picks.name: Anchor Cafe
picks.en: Beloved cafe with vegan smoothies, chia parfaits, and excellent coffee.
picks.es: Cafe querida con smoothies veganos, parfaits de chía, y café excelente.

picks.name: Northswell Cafe
picks.en: Vegan-friendly cafe with breakfast featuring multiple plant-based milk options.
picks.es: Cafe vegana con desayuno con múltiples opciones de leche a base de plantas.

picks.name: The Dock
picks.en: Beachfront restaurant famous for puttanesca and good drinks.
picks.es: Restaurante frente a playa famoso por puttanesca y bebidas buenas.

picks.name: Marietas Islands
picks.en: Popular day-trip snorkel destination with park fees and lunch included.
picks.es: Destino de snorkel popular para excursión diaria con cuotas y almuerzo incluido.

picks.name: Kapital Bank
picks.en: Recently reopened bank with reliable ATM access.
picks.es: Banco recientemente reabierto con acceso confiable a cajero automático.

picks.name: El Espresso
picks.en: Central cafe with reliable ATM access.
picks.es: Cafe central con acceso confiable a cajero automático.

picks.name: M&F Coffee Roasters
picks.en: Small coffee roastery with quality roasts from local regions.
picks.es: Pequeño tostador de café con tostadas de calidad de regiones locales.

picks.name: Tropical House Cafe
picks.en: Sports bar with breakfast service and lively atmosphere.
picks.es: Bar de deportes con servicio de desayuno y ambiente animado.

picks.name: The Embers
picks.en: Live music venue that transforms into dance club at night.
picks.es: Lugar de música en vivo que se transforma en club de baile.

picks.name: Rincón de Guayabitos
picks.en: Nearby beach town with more affordable accommodations.
picks.es: Pueblo playa cercano con alojamientos más asequibles.

picks.name: Choco Banana
picks.en: Casual spot with surprisingly good bean burgers.
picks.es: Lugar casual con hamburguesas de frijoles sorprendentemente buenas.

picks.name: Matiz Mariscos
picks.en: Popular seafood spot; try the tuna tostada.
picks.es: Lugar de mariscos popular; prueba la tostada de atún.

picks.name: Naty's Cocina
picks.en: Amazing vegetarian and vegan tacos at great prices; daytime only.
picks.es: Tacos vegetarianos y veganos increíbles a precios excelentes; solo durante el día.

picks.name: Escondido Bar
picks.en: Cocktail bar with great deals and live music performances.
picks.es: Bar de cócteles con excelentes ofertas y actuaciones de música en vivo.

picks.name: Tierra Tropical Beach Club
picks.en: Beautiful beach club with pool, food, and spa services.
picks.es: Club de playa hermoso con piscina, comida, y servicios de spa.

picks.name: Marea Cafe
picks.en: Charming affordable cafe with amazing breakfast and great vibe.
picks.es: Cafe encantador y asequible con desayuno increíble y ambiente excelente.

picks.name: Carbon
picks.en: Cozy street patio with open kitchen on quiet north side.
picks.es: Patio de calle acogedor con cocina abierta en lado norte tranquilo.

picks.name: El Itacate
picks.en: Good vegan taco options and amazing fresh drinks.
picks.es: Buenas opciones de tacos veganos y bebidas frescas increíbles.

picks.name: Tiburón
picks.en: Excellent fish restaurant with creative dishes and cocktails.
picks.es: Restaurante de pez excelente con platillos creativos y cócteles.

picks.name: Julia's Jungle Kitchen
picks.en: Breakfast spot with great coffee inside Nawalli's Plaza.
picks.es: Lugar de desayuno con café excelente dentro de Nawalli's Plaza.

tips.en: Rent golf carts or ATVs (500 pesos daily) to explore beyond walking.
tips.es: Rente carritos de golf o ATVs (500 pesos diarios) para explorar.
